facts.fact: 开头：一小时后 Lily 站在体育中心屋顶的无边泳池里，身边有一群孩子。
facts.anchor: An hour later, Lily was standing in the infinity pool on the rooftop of the sports complex.

facts.fact: Lily 觉得父母只顾亲热，没注意她晚饭时的难过，自己在家里像个外人。
facts.anchor: Her parents were now attached at the lips and hadn’t even seemed to notice she’d been upset at dinner.

facts.fact: 一名剪短发的女 Lookout 出面制止几个孩子，要求他们删除偷拍 Lily 的视频。
facts.anchor: Someone reported you for filming this guest without her permission,” said Choppy Bob.

facts.fact: Milo 告诉 Lily，他和 Kurt 因那晚的事被踢出了 Junior Counselor 培训项目。
facts.anchor: The managers found out about what we did, so they kicked both of us out of the training program,” Milo said.

facts.fact: Milo 趁没人注意塞给 Lily 一张字迹潦草的字条，约她到 Welcome Center 有绝密事相告。
facts.anchor: It was a note from Milo, written in typical boy scrawl.

facts.fact: Milo 说明妈妈是野生动物保护者，在德州一家大型康复中心工作，他自幼熟悉动物。
facts.anchor: my mom is a wildlife conservationist. She works at a big rehabilitation center back in Texas,” he said.

facts.fact: Milo 上报后曾被三名穿西装的男子拉进会议室盘问近一小时，怀疑他撞见了不该看到的事。
facts.anchor: I was pulled into a conference room. By three men in suits. I have no idea who they were.

facts.fact: 结尾：两人约好第二天九点在滨海步道尽头碰头找证据，并互问年龄，发现两人都十三岁。
facts.anchor: For now, let’s just plan to meet up at the end of the promenade around nine tomorrow, got it?
